rotorcraft_pad.provenance: Triglav field layout: the pad stands on the Rateče meadow 12 m south of the pilot, between the pilot and the strip, nose east. Footprint, aircraft envelope, clearance margin and keepouts are the default field's simulator estimates, not measured geometry or RC safety standards. The rotorpad is a zero-relief support patch on the surveyed terrain.
